facts.fact: Citi Newsroom reports the Controller and Accountant-General's Department memo of 11 February 2026 requires public employees to log onto the government payroll platform with their NIA number, which is integrated with the National Identification Authority database and flags numbers that fail to match biometric records.

Citi Newsroom reports the Controller and Accountant-General's Department runs a mechanised government payroll and has rolled out a new e-Payslip platform linked to it, with staff of several services covered.

GHA.note: No enrolment count or share given.
Who operates or maintains the ID system is not stated.

facts.fact: Citi Newsroom reports the government payroll platform is integrated with the National Identification Authority database and payroll entries are keyed on NIA numbers, with employees logging on using them, per the Controller and Accountant-General's memo of 11 February 2026.
Citi Newsroom reports the National Identification Authority holds official biometric records behind the Ghana Card and the NIA numbers on government payroll are matched against them.
